traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 genus aggregate for Rubus (gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv, read): specific gravity 0.4 (wsg_est, the hierarchical-model genus mean, from 87 records in 8 sources); trunks 0.4, branches 0.43.
